# ADR 0007: Sample packets generated by script

- Status: accepted
- Date: 2026-10-26

## Context

Hand-written hex and field values contain wrong lengths, checksums and padding, which mislead learners.

## Decision

`tools/packet-builder.py` builds every sample packet and emits its field map; pages embed that output. CI fails when an embedded packet differs from the builder.

## Consequences

Packet views are correct by construction. Adding a message type means extending the builder first.
